demos.name: PingOne Sign-in LAB
demos.description: An offline mock of a PingOne pi.flow sign-in: drive it step by step, watch the session-token cookie rotate, and see step-up (RFC 9470) and CIBA with a mock phone. Mock only, no tenant.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 6171, run `npm run build` once for the UI). Docker: docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1:6171 only). Mock only: no tenant, no credentials. composeFile is relative to this repo's root; the shelf resolves it against wherever the repo is checked out.
